messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: HIGH latency observed for tenant 'Nimbus' on dedicated pool-id dp-usw2-09. Alerts: request p50/p95 spike, error budget burn. Root TS: 1799992222

samir: on it. i'm oncall for the shift. which region?

maria: us-west-2 according to operator metrics. adding jordan for runtime.

jordan: joining. i've already seen increased KV cache misses and async batch queue backing up on host g10.

samir: ack. starting live mitigation — will scale pool down to isolate noisy tenant. taking node set a,b out of rotation.

maria: reproduce steps:
```
# quick check
kubectl --context prod-usw2 get pods -l pool=dp-usw2-09 -o wide
/opt/infra/bin/metrics tail --filter tenant=Nimbus --window 5m
```

jordan: logs show repeated OOM-ish GC pauses on g10, but OOM not recorded. suspect memory pressure from an eval batch.

samir: can we pin Nimbus to a smaller model variant temporarily? suggested fallback to rdx-medium-qa.

jordan: yes, routing policy supports model fallback. applying patch now: `route set dp-usw2-09 tenant:Nimbus model=rdx-medium-qa`

oncall-bot: samir accepted the incident and is the primary responder.

llewellyn: CS heads up — Nimbus is enterprise, contact frida for exec comms. customer-facing comms need ETA and mitigation summary.

frida: thanks. i'll draft an initial message to send after we confirm stability. please keep me posted on duration and whether we need SLA credit.

samir: mitigation done: isolated noisy nodes, applied model fallback, restarted affected workers. latency p95 down from 2.1s -> 220ms. error rate normalized.

jordan: confirming metrics: KV cache miss rate down 78%, batch queue length back to baseline.

maria: leaving a short runbook note: if fallback rollouts cause quality regression, we have automated rollback but we should run quick eval on 10 sample prompts.

llewellyn: will coordinate with Nimbus CSM to share an incident update. frida — do we want to offer a service credit? likely yes since p95 exceeded SLA for ~36 minutes.

frida: probably a credit. i'll draft options: 10% monthly credit or prorated hour credit. need legal check.

samir: creating post-incident tasks: RCA draft (owner: maria), exec one-pager (owner: frida), customer comms (owner: llewellyn), quality eval for fallback (owner: jordan). ETA EOD tomorrow.

jordan: logging steps for RCA:
- root cause: memory pressure from runaway eval job (unbounded batch size) on tenant Nimbus
- mitigation: isolate nodes, model fallback, restart workers, scale pool
- follow-ups: per-tenant batch limits, alert for KV cache miss spikes, automated fallback test

maria: added links to traces and raw metrics in thread: https://internal.metrics/redwood/trace/1799992222 (share restricted)

oncall-bot: incident resolved by samir at 1799992288.

samir: closing loop — system stable, customers routed, notified CS. leaving incident in 'postmortem' state. will sync tomorrow 10:30am for RCA review.

frida: draft exec note (short):
"We observed elevated latency impacting tenant Nimbus on dp-usw2-09 for ~36 minutes due to an unbounded evaluation job causing memory pressure. Immediate mitigations included node isolation and temporary model fallback; service fully restored. We are proposing a customer credit and long-term fixes including per-tenant batching limits and KV cache alerts. RCA and action plan to follow."

llewellyn: i'll send an empathetic customer-facing update after the RCA check. thanks team. :pray:

samir: thanks all. great work coordinating the mitigation.
